summary: Kontoor Brands filed an 8-K reporting amendments to its bylaws adopted by the Board, effective after the 2026 annual meeting. The amendments update virtual meeting authority, expand shareholder disclosure requirements for proposals and nominations, adjust advance notice deadlines, impose Rule 14a-19 compliance for nominees, mandate a white proxy card for soliciting shareholders, and specify inspector provisions. This is a routine governance update, not a special situation. No deal terms are present.
